about_short_description.short_description: Next generation HR data platform, turning employee data into insights

product.name: AI Chart Builder
product.description: A tool that generates data visualizations from plain text queries to simplify HR data analysis.

product.name: Advanced Data Permissions
product.description: A feature that provides granular control over data access at the field level within the HR analytics platform.

product.name: Saved Charts
product.description: A functionality that allows users to save and reuse charts for easier sharing and reporting within the platform.

product.name: Editable Metric Catalog
product.description: A customizable catalog that lets administrators modify metric titles, descriptions, tags, and default chart types to align analytics with company language and needs.

product.name: Explore Page
product.description: A streamlined interface for quick, ad-hoc HR data analysis without the need for multiple dashboards.

product.name: Heatmap Chart
product.description: A visualization tool that uses color intensity to display data patterns and outliers in HR datasets.
